title: Swarm wave 5: zwp_text_input_v3 IME path, tool.updated transcript rows

swarm.convention: GY-WAVE2-SWARM (concurrent agents, exclusive crate ownership, frozen interface contract, central integration gate)

assignments.J1: goya-wayland: client-side zwp_text_input_v3 — set_text_input_active(bool) (safe no-op without the global), PlatformEvent::Preedit(Option<String>) / CommitText(String) emitted atomically on protocol done frames, pure TextInputState machine (8 tests incl. a found-and-fixed clear-must-arm bug), activation decision helper
assignments.J2: goya-zcode: tool.updated wire decode (toolCallId dedup key separate from display name; scheduled silent, progress folded to Started, terminal-dedup, bounded in-flight/finished sets cap 32), append-only tool rows (⚙ tool … / ✓ / ✗), composer preedit «…» overlay + commit_text insert-at-cursor, set_text_input_active on focus changes

integration_findings: kaptaind had staged a divergent IME design (ImeBatch with serial/delete-surrounding) into goya-wayland and goya-runtime mid-flight; J1 replaced the wayland surface per the frozen contract, and J2's bin converged on it. goya-runtime retains its own unrelated Event::ImeBatch variant — it compiles independently and was left untouched (no crate owns a scrub this wave; flagged for a future goya-runtime pass).
cargo fmt across agent output (formatting-only diffs).

verification.zcode_monitor_headless: all 15 checks PASS (incl. tool-row started/progress/completed/failed lifecycle and composer preedit overlay)
verification.zcode_monitor_stdin_dump_live: link Connecting->Up, subscribed to live session

scope_honesty.ime: Protocol plumbing is unit-tested; real CJK IME operation (candidate windows, composition engines) is compositor+IME dependent and remains an OPERATOR-VERIFIED item, not proven here.
scope_honesty.tool_rows: Append-only lines; progress is folded into Started and not rendered in-place (line-model limitation, documented).

notes: Dead-key composition already worked via xkb Compose (wave 3); wave 5 adds the input-method protocol layer on top.
Doctests excluded per known host rustdoc LLVM issue (README).
kaptaind auto-committed agent work incrementally (with .tmp artifacts in history messages); gate verified the final tree via all workspace gates.
